summary: P1.2 done

PS-SECRET deliberately skips two classes of redact-pattern matches: a lower-case hyphenated word starting with `sk-` (the tail of slugs like `task-development-workflow`; 41 matches in this repository's plans, all false) and the value of a name=value pair that starts with `<`, `$`, `{` or `env://` (placeholders and secret references). The contract says any match of redact.PATTERNS blocks; without the filter the real plans of this repo gave 12 blocks instead of 2 and a migration would have been blocked by false positives (the risk named in the item). Real keys (digits or capitals) still block.
impact: packages/workspace/lib/workspace/safety.py `_not_a_secret`; the two filters must be kept if the rule is ever ported elsewhere; the contract text of PS-SECRET is stricter
